api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.

api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.

input.purpose: Bind menu/commandline for documented Solid Tools command “Box”; reuse owning geometry service rather than reimplement its algorithm

positive.setup: Invoke `Box` through both the Matrix menu and command line with the same valid selection; inspect resulting dispatch and geometry.
positive.expected: Menu and command line resolve to one stable command ID; the owner service executes `Box` exactly once, with correct document delta and undo. No local geometry kernel inside UI adapter.

negative.setup: Invoke `Box` with missing selection, invalid parameter or unavailable backend.
negative.expected: User-visible error/disabled reason, no successful no-op, no document mutation; does not pass simply because menu renders.

invariants: No success with only tessellation when an exact BRep is required
Do not infer success from an unrun test
